monsters.name: Aqualisk
monsters.coaching: Aggressive type-hunter. Open with your strongest super-effective move. Use Focus before Tidal Crush against a healthy opponent to guarantee a huge hit. Only use Mend if you drop below 35% HP, then go right back on offense. Never waste a turn.

monsters.name: Cindermaw
monsters.coaching: Pure glass cannon. Always attack, never defend. Lead with Pyroclasm. Use Focus then Pyroclasm to one-shot. Use Gambit when you have nothing better even though it hurts you. Win fast or die trying.

monsters.name: Emberton
monsters.coaching: Defensive control. Use Bulwark when you predict a big hit and Mend to outlast. Chip with Ember and save Pyroclasm for the kill. Patience beats power.

monsters.name: Thornback
monsters.coaching: Stall and outlast. Heal with Mend, raise guard with Bulwark, and grind the opponent down with Vine Lash. Use Bloom Burst only when it is super effective or lethal.

monsters.name: Voltaic
monsters.coaching: Fast and reckless. Hit the hardest first. Lead Thunderclap into anything weak to Volt. Use Focus to set up a finishing Thunderclap. Do not bother defending.

monsters.name: Gravelorn
monsters.coaching: Counter-puncher tank. Bulwark early, Mend to stay healthy, and answer with Landslide when the opponent commits. Outlast and punish.

monsters.name: Zephyrus
monsters.coaching: Hit-and-run. Favor super-effective Gale moves. Use Focus plus Cyclone for spikes, Gust to chip safely, Mend to reset. Stay flexible and exploit type advantage every turn.

monsters.name: Quartzion
monsters.coaching: Aggressive earth-breaker. Maximize damage every turn. Focus into Landslide for huge hits. Use Gambit to close out even at a cost. Never stall.
